definitionZh: 宽度 CSS 属性设置元素宽度 。 默认情况下,它会设置内容区域的宽度,但如果将框大小设置为边框,则会设置边框区域的宽度.
sourceDefinition: The width CSS property sets an element's width. By default, it sets the width of the content area, but if box-sizing is set to border-box, it sets the width of the border area.
